scope.model: CPU-side document/range/style/editor transactions. Document/RangeSet cases do not use a text system. State dispatch uses a no-render headless context; setup/Entity teardown excluded.
scope.frames: NoopTextSystem headless render/layout/prepaint/scene work. No OS/Cosmic font shaping, rasterization, presentation or GPU. No GUI FPS inference.
scope.cold_layout: Setup creates populated state before opening a window whose first render has no editor attached. Attach flag changes without notify. Preflight proves total render count unchanged from empty-shell baseline and no final-paragraph bounds. Timed refresh+draw performs first full-document editor render; afterward counter is baseline+1 and final bounds exist. Setup and teardown excluded.
scope.warm_layout: Explicit window.refresh+draw forces one view render of an already-shaped document. Localized edit and width/foreground mutation are nested inside the same update_window closure as refresh+draw, avoiding a separate effect-flush redraw; preflight verifies count+1. Localized edit includes transaction build, dispatch/history and one draw. State/frame setup/warmup/teardown excluded.
scope.document: Edit cases exclude O(1) snapshot setup and Criterion batched output destruction; internal temporary destruction remains included. Legacy-as-str includes first edited snapshot flatten. Cheap clone uses iter, including returned-handle destruction.
scope.uncertainty: Confidence bounds describe this local run; no cross-machine or interactive frame-rate guarantee.
scope.invalidation: Width alternates 320/640 logical px; text_style_invalidation toggles foreground color on 128 paragraphs. Each measured mutation includes its one verified render/draw.
scope.throughput: Criterion Document throughput expressed as Bytes(document_size) is input-size normalization, not measured bytes actually processed by snapshot cloning or localized edits, and must not be interpreted as memory bandwidth. Query element throughput counts the explicitly defined batch operations; absolute nanosecond estimates remain the primary result.

retention_observation.flattening: Clones share snapshot lazy contiguous buffer; edited snapshots allocate distinct buffers on first contiguous read.
retention_observation.cache: Retains active document paragraph layouts; no historical FIFO, no viewport or byte budget.
retention_observation.history: Up to 1,000 entries share text/style payloads but retain changed chunks and coordinate/index arrays.

verification_status: All 36 published cases come from verified measured routines: 28 unchanged model/state cases retained from the first successful run and 8 corrected frame cases from the second run. Per-case provenance identifies the run and whole benchmark source SHA.
